Oil Prices Surge Above $104 Amid Hormuz Attacks and Hurricane Fears

Global oil prices have surpassed $104 per barrel, driven by concerns over supply disruptions. Attacks on tankers in the Strait of Hormuz have reached a "wartime high," with Iran reportedly attempting to restrict oil exports. Concurrently, Hurricane Isaias has raised further supply fears. These events have caused significant volatility in oil markets, pushing tanker attacks deeper into the Gulf.
